_doc: Day-by-day narrative + companions for the Japan trip. Pulled from Notion daily logs. Day 1 = 2026-04-18 (land day). Day 10 = 2026-04-27 (return).

days.title: Departure
days.summary: Bryan boards UA803 IAD-HND at 12:30, crossing the international date line en route to Tokyo.

days.title: Land + Ginza first night
days.summary: Lands at HND 15:55 and explores Ginza by night, with subway orientation, taxi rides, and a sober izakaya dinner before discovering Kabuki-za next to the hotel.
moments: Tokyo taxi with anime ad on touchscreen
Iyoshi Cola izakaya with tablet ordering, sober (cola + water)
Walked past Mikimoto Ginza and ZARA

days.title: Tsukiji to Senso-ji to Park
days.summary: A 15-hour cross-Tokyo Sunday: pre-dawn Tsukiji, daylight Senso-ji, then Meiji Jingu's camphor tree and Yoyogi Park forest, capped with a drugstore haul.
moments: Meiji Jingu sacred camphor tree + ema plaque wall

days.title: Team arrives + Tonkatsu
days.summary: Team arrives in Tokyo; Bryan joins a tonkatsu group lunch (4 people), wanders Marunouchi, then closes with a traditional izakaya dinner near Mitsui Garden Hotel.
moments: Traditional izakaya team dinner, fried mushrooms

days.title: JNI day + IBREN
days.summary: First view of Skytree from the hotel; JNI deep-dive in Kagurazaka with a formal visitor badge, then a sober jasmine-tea dinner at IBREN in Akihabara while the team drinks.
moments: External Visitor Temporary Pass at Ichigaya
IBREN Akihabara dinner, ¥8,514, jasmine tea sober

days.title: CAO Cabinet Office + yakitori
days.summary: Daily 5 AM gym + onsen routine, hotel-coworking morning, then the trip's biggest government engagement at the Cabinet Office in Kasumigaseki, capped by a deep-cut yakitori dinner.
moments: 5 AM hotel gym + nude public spa daily
Yakitori specialty cuts: knee cartilage, tsunagi, momotare, quail eggs

days.title: NSSOL day + Kaiseki
days.opening_quote: I felt so humbled. I never thought I would conduct business in a Tokyo highrise.
days.summary: Bryan suits up for an NSSOL deep-dive in a Tokyo highrise, meets counterpart researcher Moroboshi, and ends with a kaiseki group dinner at a zen-style restaurant.
moments: Dark business suit hotel mirror selfie
NSSOL group photo at zen restaurant

days.title: Zojoji + DIH MoD + Suimei
days.summary: Stood on Zojoji's Buddha's Footprints stone and prayed for guidance, captured the iconic Zojoji + Tokyo Tower frame, met at DIH/MoD Ichigaya, then closed with Darren's send-off shabu-shabu at Suimei where all six nationalities signed the menu.
moments: Prayed on Zojoji's Bussokuseki (Buddha's Footprints) stone
DIH meeting at Ministry of Defense, Ichigaya
Signed menu with 6 nationalities, Clarice's bald-Bryan doodle

days.title: Tokyo to Kyoto: Fushimi Inari + Gion
days.summary: Shinkansen straight to Fushimi Inari, hiked deep into Mt. Inari, rescued two lost Singaporean women and walked them to the train station, then Kamogawa River dusk and yukata at the Kyoto hotel.
moments: Vermilion torii corridor + sub-shrines on Mt. Inari
Rescued two lost Singaporean women, walked them down to the station
Komeda Coffee Pokemon promo, kuro-neige baumkuchen
Kamogawa River first Kyoto night walk
Wore yukata at the Kyoto hotel

days.title: Kyoto Trail + Himukai + Pokemon
days.summary: Hiked the Kyoto Round Trail Higashiyama marker #37 to Himukai Daijingu ('Kyoto's Ise'), shinkansen back to Tokyo, then a 22-item ¥35,213 Pokemon Center haul and late wagyu dinner.
moments: Mossy mountain trail + sacred spring walkway
Late wagyu dinner at 5th-gen 1962 merchant restaurant

days.title: Senso-ji sunrise + HND home
days.summary: Closed the trip where it began: a return sunrise visit to Senso-ji, hotel packing, a 1877 Meiji-era plate sighting, then HND ramen and UA804 home.
moments: 1877 Meiji-era plate from Philadelphia Centennial Exposition
